rare_audit.bucket_definition: Train token-frequency ranks; disjoint 0-1%, 1-5%, 5-20%, 20-80%, 80-100% vocabulary ranks, ceil boundaries; 8192 fixed validation targets; occurrence-weighted arithmetic mean of -log P(correct). No checkpoint-dependent membership.
rare_audit.tie_policy: Existing NumPy argsort(counts)[::-1], fixed population/rank hash; no ranking change in PHASE47.

training_interval_exposure.note: Observed exposure counts, not a causal test of corpus composition.

limitations: Rare probe is a small fixed validation subset, not all rare-language ability.
Taxonomy describes decoded fragments; proper names/foreign words cannot reliably be inferred from isolated BPE bytes.
Classification thresholds are descriptive: >0.05 CE in all seeds for broad regression; otherwise seed-local; top10 >=50% positive contributions for concentration.
rare_audit.taxonomy_caveat: Class contributions must be compared with occurrence counts; Japanese fragments dominate this Japanese probe, so counts alone do not establish a class-specific defect.

selection_policy.description: All candidates use the unchanged Phase46 evaluator. Candidate selection is multi-metric, not minimum loss. Tolerances govern this experiment only; Phase46 recorded gate remains unchanged.
selection_policy.greedy_note: Runaway alone never rejects. Earlier loop onset together with higher repetition and confidence is negative evidence; isolated conflicting loop signals are reported as mixed, not decisive.
selection_policy.selection: A reduced LR is a clear candidate only if all safety checks pass, Rare CE improves by >=0.05 versus A, and loop onset/repetition/confidence do not jointly worsen. Among eligible candidates prefer lower Rare CE; difference <0.02 prefers the smaller LR change (B). If none qualify, best=null and no further-seed training.
selection_policy.confirmation: Reuse selected seed42 experiment, train only remaining seeds 123 and 2026 once. Apply same checks to each seed and report aggregate. Never promote experimental checkpoints.

attractor_method: Existing PHASE46 descriptive heuristic; not a changed experiment selection rule.

lr_too_high_evidence.reason: Reduced LR decreases seed42 gradient variance, but 1e-4 seed42 Rare CE remains within 0.05 tolerance and sampling improves from baseline. The specified joint signature of 1e-4-only Rare and generation deterioration is not established.

interval_reason: Single 256k controlled interval; seed variability and mixed generation signals do not support doubling to 512k.
